role.en: CEO, SpaceX (incl. xAI / SpaceXAI); CEO, Tesla

why.en: Redefined the tempo of the compute arms race with Colossus. After folding xAI into SpaceX he now controls a model–rocket–car–robot stack no one else has, heading into what would be the largest IPO in history.
why.zh: 以 Colossus 的建设速度重新定义了算力军备竞赛的节奏。将 xAI 并入 SpaceX 后，他掌握着无人可比的「模型—火箭—车—机器人」闭环，并正走向史上最大规模的 IPO。

title.en: Running commentary on Grok, Colossus and the SpaceXAI merge
title.zh: 关于 Grok、Colossus 与 SpaceXAI 合并的持续发言

note.en: His primary and effectively only publishing channel; product and roadmap news usually breaks here first.
note.zh: 他的主要且实际上唯一的发布渠道，产品与路线图消息通常先在此出现。

title.en: xAI dissolves into SpaceX as SpaceXAI
title.zh: xAI 并入 SpaceX，更名 SpaceXAI

note.en: Grok and the other AI products move under SpaceX's corporate structure rather than remaining an independent entity.
note.zh: Grok 与其他 AI 产品转入 SpaceX 的公司架构，不再作为独立实体存在。

title.en: Grok 4.6 weeks away, 4.7 to follow
title.zh: Grok 4.6 数周内发布，4.7 紧随其后

note.en: 4.6 at 1.5T parameters; 4.7 at 2.1T, 'better in every way except slightly slower to serve'.
note.zh: 4.6 为 1.5 万亿参数；4.7 为 2.1 万亿，「除服务速度略慢外全面更强」。

title.en: We’re just going to have @Grok Bots manage Grokipedia
title.zh: We’re just going to have @Grok Bots manage Grokipedia

note.en: Musk says Grok bots will manage Grokipedia, signaling AI-run moderation and curation for the encyclopedia project.
note.zh: 马斯克表示将让Grok机器人来管理Grokipedia，意味着这个百科项目将由AI负责运营和审核。

title.en: Using Grok @Bot is like hiring a super smart, hard-working person for peanuts
title.zh: Using Grok @Bot is like hiring a super smart, hard-working person for peanuts

note.en: Musk argues using the Grok bot is like hiring a highly capable worker for a fraction of the cost, making the case for Grok's value.
note.zh: 马斯克称使用Grok机器人就像以极低成本雇到一位能力超强的员工，为Grok的价值进行辩护。

title.en: Dear Prime Minister Ambani, Please accept my humble apologies for not realizing that you are the real boss of India. Naturally, you would prefer to maintain you
title.zh: Dear Prime Minister Ambani, Please accept my humble apologies for not realizing that you are the real boss of India. Naturally, you would prefer to maintain you

note.en: Musk publicly mocked Mukesh Ambani as India's "real boss," accusing him of monopolistic exploitation amid their rivalry over satellite internet access in India.
note.zh: 马斯克公开嘲讽穆克什·安巴尼是印度的“真正统治者”，指责其在印度卫星互联网业务上实施垄断剥削，双方的竞争持续升级。

title.en: Grok @Bot can now set up its own email
title.zh: Grok @Bot can now set up its own email

note.en: Musk announced that Grok's bot agent can now set up its own email account, a small but concrete step toward more autonomous AI agents.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布Grok的机器人智能体现在可以自主创建电子邮箱，这是AI智能体迈向更高自主性的一个具体进展。

title.en: 🇧🇩 Starlink Mobile now available in Bangladesh! 🇧🇩
title.zh: 🇧🇩 Starlink Mobile now available in Bangladesh! 🇧🇩

note.en: Announced that Starlink Mobile direct-to-cell service has launched in Bangladesh, extending satellite connectivity to a new market.
note.zh: 宣布Starlink Mobile（星链移动直连）服务在孟加拉国上线，将卫星通信服务扩展到新市场。

title.en: Grok @Bot is like hiring an extremely competent employee!
title.zh: Grok @Bot is like hiring an extremely competent employee!

note.en: Musk frames xAI's Grok bot product as comparable to hiring a highly capable employee, publicly endorsing its usefulness.
note.zh: 马斯克将xAI的Grok机器人产品比作雇用一名能力极强的员工，公开为其实用性背书。

title.en: Starlink connecting Bangladesh!
title.zh: Starlink connecting Bangladesh!

note.en: Musk announced Starlink service connecting Bangladesh, extending the satellite network into a new market.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布星链服务接入孟加拉国，将卫星网络拓展至新市场。

title.en: Starlink will be of great help to areas of India that have bad or no Internet and even no mobile coverage. No country has perfect coverage, including America, b
title.zh: Starlink will be of great help to areas of India that have bad or no Internet and even no mobile coverage. No country has perfect coverage, including America, b

note.en: Musk argued Starlink will help cover connectivity gaps in parts of India lacking internet or mobile service, framing it as a complement rather than a replacement for existing coverage.
note.zh: 马斯克表示星链将帮助弥补印度部分地区互联网和移动网络覆盖不足的问题，并强调星链是对现有网络的补充而非替代。

title.en: People who oppose @Starlink hurt only the least-served. The wealthy or those living in large cities already have good Internet, so they don’t understand.
title.zh: People who oppose @Starlink hurt only the least-served. The wealthy or those living in large cities already have good Internet, so they don’t understand.

note.en: Musk argues Starlink's critics are mostly wealthy or urban people who already have good internet — a public defense of Starlink's reach amid India's access dispute.
note.zh: 马斯克表示反对星链的人大多是已拥有良好网络的富裕或城市人群，这是他在印度准入争议期间为星链覆盖范围所做的公开辩护。

title.en: Starlink provides Internet connectivity to the least-served, enabling self-education and prosperity by giving people access to sell their products worldwide!
title.zh: Starlink provides Internet connectivity to the least-served, enabling self-education and prosperity by giving people access to sell their products worldwide!

note.en: Musk frames Starlink as enabling self-education and global market access for underserved populations, continuing his public case for the service.
note.zh: 马斯克称星链能让服务欠缺地区的人们实现自我教育并将产品销往全球，延续了他为该服务做的公开辩护。

title.en: 🇮🇳 Starlink will help the least-served in India 🇮🇳
title.zh: 🇮🇳 Starlink will help the least-served in India 🇮🇳

note.en: Musk singles out India, saying Starlink will help its underserved populations — a direct response amid the dispute over India's satellite-internet approval process.
note.zh: 马斯克特别提到印度，称星链将帮助当地服务欠缺人群，这是他针对印度卫星互联网审批争议的直接回应。

title.en: Starlink is licensed in over 165 countries and has spent five years complying with every single law and requirement of the government of India, so why still no
title.zh: Starlink is licensed in over 165 countries and has spent five years complying with every single law and requirement of the government of India, so why still no

note.en: Musk publicly accused India of blocking Starlink's launch despite Starlink being licensed in over 165 countries, intensifying a regulatory dispute.
note.zh: 马斯克公开指责印度阻挠Starlink落地，称Starlink已在165多个国家获得许可，矛盾进一步升级。

title.en: Yes, they are traitors aiding an invasion and they deserve the fate of traitors
title.zh: Yes, they are traitors aiding an invasion and they deserve the fate of traitors

note.en: Musk called certain individuals traitors deserving "the fate of traitors," an inflammatory post that drew heavy engagement.
note.zh: 马斯克发帖称某些人是叛徒，应承受“叛徒的命运”，这条言辞激烈的帖子引发大量互动。

title.en: Starlink coming to KLM!
title.zh: Starlink coming to KLM!

note.en: Musk announced Starlink is coming to KLM, extending in-flight connectivity to another major airline.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布Starlink将登陆荷航（KLM），为另一家主要航空公司提供机上网络服务。

title.en: Grok @Bot works well on your phone. Just download the app from Apple or Android. https://t.co/Efbxq5vqTm
title.zh: Grok @Bot works well on your phone. Just download the app from Apple or Android. https://t.co/Efbxq5vqTm

note.en: Musk promoted the Grok Bot app being available for download on iOS and Android.
note.zh: 马斯克宣传Grok Bot应用已可在iOS和Android上下载。

title.en: Grok 4.7 ranks first in legal matters
title.zh: Grok 4.7 ranks first in legal matters

note.en: Musk claimed Grok 4.7 ranks first among models on legal-domain benchmarks.
note.zh: 马斯克称Grok 4.7在法律相关测评中排名第一。

title.en: Starlink saves lives during natural disasters
title.zh: Starlink saves lives during natural disasters

note.en: Musk argued Starlink's connectivity has proven critical during natural disasters, tying the system to emergency response.
note.zh: 马斯克表示星链（Starlink）在自然灾害中发挥了关键的救援连接作用。

title.en: And Grok @Bot only gets better from here 🚀 🚀 You could build an entire company made of Grok Bots!
title.zh: And Grok @Bot only gets better from here 🚀 🚀 You could build an entire company made of Grok Bots!

note.en: Musk said Grok's bot capabilities keep improving and floated building entire companies out of Grok Bots, a vision statement for xAI's agent push.
note.zh: 马斯克表示Grok机器人的能力还会持续提升，并设想用Grok Bot组建整个公司，体现了xAI在智能体方向上的愿景。

title.en: This is the last critical piece of the spectrum puzzle needed for SpaceX to provide complete phone coverage in America
title.zh: This is the last critical piece of the spectrum puzzle needed for SpaceX to provide complete phone coverage in America

note.en: Musk said SpaceX has secured the last piece of spectrum needed to provide complete phone coverage across America via its satellite network.
note.zh: 马斯克表示SpaceX已拿到实现美国全境手机覆盖所需的最后一块频谱拼图。

title.en: This will sound super crazy, but I see a path to SpaceX being worth orders of magnitude more than the current Earth economy
title.zh: This will sound super crazy, but I see a path to SpaceX being worth orders of magnitude more than the current Earth economy

note.en: Musk says he sees a path for SpaceX to be worth orders of magnitude more than the entire Earth economy, underscoring his ambitions for the combined SpaceX/xAI stack.
note.zh: 马斯克表示他看到了一条让SpaceX估值达到地球经济体量数个量级之上的路径,体现了他对SpaceX/xAI整合体系的野心。

title.en: Excited to announce that all super intelligence organizations have now jointly agreed to the ultimate in AI/SI safety: Moving all testing to Delta Airlines flig
title.zh: Excited to announce that all super intelligence organizations have now jointly agreed to the ultimate in AI/SI safety: Moving all testing to Delta Airlines flig

note.en: Musk joked that all superintelligence organizations have agreed to run AI/SI safety testing on Delta Airlines flights, where there's no internet access — a widely shared quip on AI safety theater.
note.zh: 马斯克开玩笑说所有超级智能机构已一致同意将AI/SI安全测试搬到没有网络的达美航空航班上进行，这条调侃帖获得了大量转发。

title.en: Important note regarding Grok @Bot: Going forward, @SpaceX will use the best back end model for any given task, including Claude Opus 5.5, MidJourney, Suno and
title.zh: Important note regarding Grok @Bot: Going forward, @SpaceX will use the best back end model for any given task, including Claude Opus 5.5, MidJourney, Suno and

note.en: Musk announced that Grok/xAI will route tasks to whichever backend model is best for the job, including Claude Opus 5.5, Midjourney and Suno, rather than only in-house models.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布Grok/xAI未来将为每项任务调用最合适的后端模型，包括Claude Opus 5.5、Midjourney和Suno等外部模型，而不只用自家模型。

title.en: Grok @Bot will use whatever achieves the best outcome for users. Simple questions will route to small, fast models. Questions with complex answers will route to
title.zh: Grok @Bot will use whatever achieves the best outcome for users. Simple questions will route to small, fast models. Questions with complex answers will route to

note.en: Musk explains Grok's model-routing design: simple questions go to small, fast models while complex ones route to large models.
note.zh: 马斯克说明了Grok的模型路由设计：简单问题交给更快的小模型处理，复杂问题则路由到大模型。

title.en: Dragon undocks from the Space Station
title.zh: Dragon undocks from the Space Station

note.en: Musk posts on the Dragon capsule's undocking from the ISS, a real SpaceX mission update that drew over 300K views.
note.zh: 马斯克发文播报“龙”飞船与国际空间站分离，这条关于SpaceX真实任务的动态获得超过31万次浏览。

title.en: Unfortunately, we are being blocked by certain oligarchs in order to maintain their monopolistic chokehold on the Indian people. You can guess who they are … Th
title.zh: Unfortunately, we are being blocked by certain oligarchs in order to maintain their monopolistic chokehold on the Indian people. You can guess who they are … Th

note.en: Musk accused unnamed Indian business groups of blocking his companies to protect their monopoly, calling it "a crime against the people of India."
note.zh: 马斯克指责印度某些"寡头"为维护垂断地位而阻挠其公司业务,称此举"是对印度人民犯下的罪行"。

title.en: Starlink Mobile (direct-to-cell) V2 satellites are incredible. This @SpaceX constellation will enable more than 100 times the bandwidth of our current V1 system
title.zh: Starlink Mobile (direct-to-cell) V2 satellites are incredible. This @SpaceX constellation will enable more than 100 times the bandwidth of our current V1 system

note.en: Musk said SpaceX's new Starlink Mobile V2 satellites will deliver over 100x the bandwidth of the current V1 direct-to-cell constellation.
note.zh: 马斯克表示,SpaceX新一代Starlink Mobile V2卫星带宽将达到现有V1直连手机星座的100倍以上。

title.en: However, most @Bot requests are pretty simple and will be handled by a lightning-fast version of Grok 4.8 when that comes out. Operating principle is to give Gr
title.zh: However, most @Bot requests are pretty simple and will be handled by a lightning-fast version of Grok 4.8 when that comes out. Operating principle is to give Gr

note.en: Musk said most Grok Bot requests will soon be handled by a faster, lighter version of Grok 4.8, previewing the bot assistant's next iteration.
note.zh: 马斯克表示，大多数Grok Bot请求届时将由更快、更轻量的Grok 4.8版本处理，预告了该机器人助手的下一代迭代。

title.en: Starlink in India would enable high-speed, affordable Internet connectivity for those who can’t afford current prices or who don’t have a connection at all!
title.zh: Starlink in India would enable high-speed, affordable Internet connectivity for those who can’t afford current prices or who don’t have a connection at all!

note.en: Musk argued Starlink's entry into India would bring affordable high-speed internet to people who currently can't afford it or have no connection at all.
note.zh: 马斯克表示，星链进入印度将为负担不起现有价格或完全没有网络连接的人提供高速、经济实惠的互联网接入。

title.en: Starlink beams are turned off over India, so the claim that they were used by anyone for any reason is absolutely false https://t.co/y3R2L5JV7h
title.zh: Starlink beams are turned off over India, so the claim that they were used by anyone for any reason is absolutely false https://t.co/y3R2L5JV7h

note.en: Disputed a claim about Starlink's use in India, stating the service's beams there had already been turned off.
note.zh: 反驳了关于Starlink在印度被用于某种用途的说法，称当地的卫星信号早已关闭。

title.en: Grok @Bot can be your personal chief financial officer!
title.zh: Grok @Bot can be your personal chief financial officer!

note.en: Musk claims Grok can serve as a personal chief financial officer, a new positioning for the assistant's finance capabilities.
note.zh: 马斯克表示Grok可以充当个人首席财务官，这是该助手在理财功能上的新定位。

title.en: Grok 4.7 is excellent at dealing with large code repositories
title.zh: Grok 4.7 is excellent at dealing with large code repositories

note.en: Musk says Grok 4.7 handles large code repositories well, pointing to a coding-capability upgrade in the new model version.
note.zh: 马斯克表示Grok 4.7在处理大型代码仓库方面表现出色，显示新版本模型在编程能力上有所提升。

title.en: SpaceX will provide connectivity throughout the solar system and beyond
title.zh: SpaceX will provide connectivity throughout the solar system and beyond

note.en: Musk declared SpaceX's ambition to extend connectivity across the entire solar system, not just Earth orbit.
note.zh: 马斯克宣称SpaceX的目标是将连接能力扩展到整个太阳系，而不仅限于地球轨道。

title.en: Propagating super intelligence to the stars is a great success condition for a biological bootloader
title.zh: Propagating super intelligence to the stars is a great success condition for a biological bootloader

note.en: Musk argued that spreading superintelligence to the stars is itself a successful outcome for humanity as a 'biological bootloader' for AI.
note.zh: 马斯克提出，将超级智能传播到星际本身就是人类作为AI的"生物引导程序"所能达成的成功结果。

title.en: No more AI SI It’s better
title.zh: No more AI SI It’s better

note.en: Musk posted that "SI" is a better term than "AI", echoing Trump's push to rename the technology — a stance Jensen Huang has also adopted.
note.zh: 马斯克发推称“SI”比“AI”的说法更好，呼应了特朗普推动的更名说法，黄仁勋也采用了同样的说法。

title.en: SpaceX is a super intelligence company
title.zh: SpaceX is a super intelligence company

note.en: Musk declared SpaceX a 'super intelligence' company, signaling his push to frame the SpaceX–xAI combination as a frontier AI player rather than just a rocket and satellite business.
note.zh: 马斯克宣称SpaceX是一家“超级智能”公司，表明他正将SpaceX与xAI的组合定位为前沿人工智能力量，而不只是火箭和卫星业务。

title.en: Helpful guide to hiring your first @Grok @Bot employee. It really is like hiring an amazing helper that learns your needs and gets smarter almost every day!
title.zh: Helpful guide to hiring your first @Grok @Bot employee. It really is like hiring an amazing helper that learns your needs and gets smarter almost every day!

note.en: Musk pitches hiring an AI agent built on Grok/Grok Bot as if it were an employee, framing it as a hire that keeps getting smarter.
note.zh: 马斯克把基于Grok/Grok Bot的AI智能体当作"员工"来宣传招募，称其会像员工一样不断变得更聪明。

title.en: Grok 4.7 is #1 on the AA Cyber Index
title.zh: Grok 4.7 is #1 on the AA Cyber Index

note.en: Musk claims Grok 4.7 ranked #1 on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, touting the model's cybersecurity benchmark performance.
note.zh: 马斯克称Grok 4.7在Artificial Analysis的Cyber Index基准测试中排名第一，借此宣传该模型在网络安全能力上的表现。

title.en: 5 live football games streamed simultaneously on a commercial flight with @Starlink
title.zh: 5 live football games streamed simultaneously on a commercial flight with @Starlink

note.en: Musk highlighted Starlink streaming five live football games simultaneously on a commercial flight, showcasing in-flight connectivity bandwidth.
note.zh: 马斯克展示了Starlink在商业航班上同时直播五场足球比赛的能力，凸显其机上网络带宽实力。

title.zh: Robotaxi operating hours moved from 10pm to 11pm. The main thing we’re trying to solve is making sure that we don’t run over pets when they’re hard to see at ni

note.en: Musk pushed Tesla's Robotaxi service hours back from 10pm to 11pm, citing difficulty spotting animals like grey cats at night as the main safety concern.
note.zh: 马斯克将特斯拉Robotaxi的运营时间从晚上10点推迟到11点，称主要是为了避免夜间难以看清灰猫等小动物而发生意外。

title.zh: Starship deploying Starlink V3 satellites https://t.co/TG7b8iHYkY

note.en: Musk posted video of a SpaceX Starship deploying Starlink V3 satellites, the latest step in scaling the next-generation satellite constellation.
note.zh: 马斯克发布了星舰部署星链V3卫星的视频，这是下一代卫星星座扩展计划的最新进展。

title.zh: Grokipedia v0.3 just released. Join @SpaceXAI if you want to create Encyclopedia Galactica!

note.en: Musk announced the release of Grokipedia v0.3 and invited people to join SpaceXAI to help build it out.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布Grokipedia v0.3版本发布，并邀请公众加入SpaceXAI共同参与建设。

title.en: Three Falcons ready to fly simultaneously
title.zh: Three Falcons ready to fly simultaneously

note.en: Musk says three Falcon rockets are prepped to fly simultaneously, a snapshot of SpaceX's current launch cadence.
note.zh: 马斯克表示三枚猎鹰火箭已准备好同时发射，展现了SpaceX当前的发射节奏。

title.en: Both @United and @AmericanAir have @Starlink! https://t.co/7EfINWq1nU
title.zh: Both @United and @AmericanAir have @Starlink! https://t.co/7EfINWq1nU

note.en: Musk announced that both United and American Airlines now offer Starlink in-flight Wi-Fi, marking wider commercial-airline adoption of the service.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布美国联合航空和美国航空均已上线星链机载WiFi，标志着星链在商业航空领域的进一步普及。

title.en: Each @SpaceX Star Mind super intelligence spacecraft will have over 250kW of solar power, which is about 20% more than the International Space Station
title.zh: Each @SpaceX Star Mind super intelligence spacecraft will have over 250kW of solar power, which is about 20% more than the International Space Station

note.en: Musk detailed specs for SpaceX's Star Mind superintelligence spacecraft, citing over 250kW of solar power, about 20% more than the ISS.
note.zh: 马斯克介绍了SpaceX「Star Mind」超级智能飞船的参数,其太阳能发电能力超过250千瓦,比国际空间站高出约20%。

title.en: Major speed improvements to @Bot
title.zh: Major speed improvements to @Bot

note.en: Musk announced major speed improvements to Grok's bot/assistant feature.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布Grok机器人助手功能获得重大速度提升。

title.en: Grok @Bot is an amazing assistant
title.zh: Grok @Bot is an amazing assistant

note.en: Musk praised Grok's bot assistant as 'amazing,' continuing his public push for xAI's Grok product.
note.zh: 马斯克称赞Grok的机器人助手“令人惊艳”，持续为xAI的Grok产品造势。

title.en: The nation owes a debt to @JGebbia and his excellent team. They worked incredibly hard, with no compensation, to make government services work better for all Am
title.zh: The nation owes a debt to @JGebbia and his excellent team. They worked incredibly hard, with no compensation, to make government services work better for all Am

note.en: Musk publicly thanked Joe Gebbia's team for unpaid work improving U.S. government services, a DOGE-era initiative.
note.zh: 马斯克公开感谢Joe Gebbia团队无偿改善美国政府服务的工作，这是DOGE时期的举措。

title.en: Grok 4.7 rank 1 on AA cyber index
title.zh: Grok 4.7 rank 1 on AA cyber index

title.en: Best way to sandbox an AI is to put it on a Delta flight – it will have no chance of accessing the Internet!
title.zh: Best way to sandbox an AI is to put it on a Delta flight – it will have no chance of accessing the Internet!
